### New look

- The settings window has been redesigned with a side menu and new page layouts

### Settings

- Settings that apply right away no longer save your other unsaved changes with them
- Closing the window now warns about any unsaved change
- Only two frame rate caps remain: the FastFlags limit and the Roblox settings file cap
- Text boxes, dropdowns and hint texts fit their content and name the right pages

### Safety

- Saved alt accounts no longer overwrite each other's login; affected accounts ask to be added again
- Settings and account files can no longer be half written or overwritten with an old copy
- Asset Warp's certificate now only works for Roblox addresses and its key is protected
- Your PhasmaStrap sign-in is stored encrypted
- Party and Discord joins check the server details before launching

### Fixes

- Forced resolution, power plan and Game Bar settings are put back properly, even after a crash
- The Accounts tab no longer crashes after switching tabs
- Joining a friend's or private server is no longer redirected by the server picker
- Web requests are no longer sent several times
- Background features run in one PhasmaStrap process instead of several
- Many crashes and freezes across the dialogs, overlays, game chat and settings pages
- A game's places list no longer disappears under a long list of private servers
- Your account picture shows again next to your name
- Restarting and uninstalling no longer run hidden command windows
